ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can record every feeding, but only a caretaker who spends each day by the enclosure notices that a cat's expression and appetite are different today.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 392,100 animal caretakers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to reach 439,600 by 2034, a net increase of about 47,500 jobs, with roughly 74,600 openings each year. Median annual pay was about $33,500 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace animal caretakers, but it will take over files and records. Software increasingly handles feeding logs, health records, and boarding appointments. Feeding, cleaning, observation, and comfort still require physical presence and a trained eye that machines cannot replace.
ai_s2_accel: AI cameras that monitor animal activity and unusual behavior
Smart feeders and water-intake monitoring devices
Health-data apps that support weight and appetite tracking
Pet identification linked automatically to records
ai_s2_auto: Digital feeding and health records
Software for boarding appointments and customer records
Cloud-based pet profiles and vaccination records
Automated basic reports and revenue summaries
ai_s3_list: On-site observation and abnormal-condition assessment: quickly seeing whether an animal is eating, drinking, and behaving normally.
Animal restraint and care techniques: administering medication, trimming nails, and cleaning with steady, controlled hands.
Emotional reassurance: fearful, stressed, or abandoned animals need patient human contact to build trust.
Emergency response: judging promptly whether a bite, heat illness, or diarrhea needs veterinary care.
Communication with owners and adopters: explaining an animal's condition clearly so trust can develop.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 3/10 score reflects the occupation's small share of desk work. Software is taking over records and files, but most duties happen on site, leaving limited room for direct AI replacement.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low AI exposure does not mean no change. AI mainly improves management efficiency, freeing caretakers from manual logs so they can spend more time with animals. Workers who only feed mechanically face pressure, while people skilled in observation and care become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If a student genuinely loves animals, education in veterinary technology, animal science, or pet care offers a stronger path than treating it only as a hobby. In the AI era, caretakers with health-observation and nursing skills can advance into veterinary-assistant or store-management roles.

Use software for health records and file management, then spend the saved time improving observation and nursing skills. Earn credentials in pet grooming, dog training, or veterinary assistance and build complementary expertise beyond basic cleanup.

Start as an animal-shelter volunteer or pet-store associate to gain experience. On your resume, describe how many animals you cared for independently and the types of unusual conditions you handled. Career changers with nursing or education backgrounds have an advantage.

Do not hire caretakers based only on affection for animals. Look for observation skills and responsibility. People who document carefully, understand basic care, and handle emergencies are better long-term investments.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Boarding appointments, memberships, and records management
Alerts for unusual behavior and activity
Automatic litter cleaning and water replacement
Rapid temperature checks and basic examinations

ai_s7_trends: As the pet economy scales, demand is growing for professional boarding and care. Entry-level jobs are plentiful, but skills drive advancement.
AI and smart devices are taking over files and feeding records, returning caretakers' time to the animals.
Health observation and nursing skills are becoming key differentiators, helping versatile caretakers advance into veterinary-assistant and store-manager roles.

body: Animal Caretakers (Animal Caretakers) feed, clean, observe, and provide basic daily care for animals. They maintain sanitary enclosures and animal welfare and assist veterinarians with simple medical tasks and records.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can record every feeding, but only a caretaker who spends each day by the enclosure notices that a cat's expression and appetite are different today.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能帮你记录每一顿喂食，但那只猫今天眼神不对、胃口变差，只有天天蹲在笼前的照护员知道。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年动物照护员在岗约 39.21 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 43.96 万人，净增约 4.75 万个岗位，年均产生约 7.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.35 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代动物照护员，但会接管档案和记录。喂食记录、健康档案、寄养预约，这些桌面活正被软件接手。剩下的喂饲、清理、观察、安抚，全是现场体力加眼力的活，机器替代不了。
ai_s2_accel: AI 摄像头监测动物活动与异常行为
智能喂食器与饮水监测设备
健康数据 App 辅助体重与食欲追踪
宠物识别与档案自动关联
ai_s2_auto: 喂食与健康记录电子化
寄养预约与客户档案管理软件
宠物档案与免疫记录云端化
基础报表与营收统计自动化
ai_s3_list: 现场观察与异常判断：吃不吃、喝不喝、精神好不好，一眼能看出问题。
动物保定与护理手法：给药、剪甲、清洁，手上的分寸要稳。
情感安抚：怕人、应激、被弃养的动物，得靠耐心慢慢建立信任。
突发处理：咬伤、中暑、拉稀，第一时间判断要不要送医。
与主人/领养人的沟通：把动物的状态讲清楚，让信任建立起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 3/10 说明这个职业的案头比重很低——记录、档案正被软件接管，但绝大部分工作在现场，AI 直接替代的空间有限。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 低曝光不等于没变化。AI 主要提升的是「管理效率」，把照护员从记台账里解放出来，多花时间在动物身上。真正被挤压的是「只会机械喂食」的岗位，懂观察、会护理的人反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 如果孩子真心喜欢动物，走动物医学、畜牧或宠物养护专业更稳，别只当爱好。AI 时代，懂健康观察和护理的照护员能往兽医助理、店长方向走，天花板更高。
把健康记录和档案管理用软件做起来，省下时间练观察和护理。考宠物美容、训犬、兽医助理等证书，往复合技能方向升级，别停留在「纯铲屎」。
从收容所志愿者或宠物店店员起步攒经验，简历里多写「独立照顾过XX只动物、处理过XX类异常」这类具体事。有护理、教育背景的转岗者更有优势。
招照护员别只看「爱动物」，要看观察力和责任心。会记录、懂护理、能处理突发的人，比单纯有爱心的人更值得长期培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 寄养预约、会员与档案管理

ai_s7_trends: 宠物经济规模化，寄养、护理等专业照护需求增长，入门岗多、晋升靠技能。
AI 与智能设备接管档案和喂养记录，照护员的时间回到动物身边。
健康观察与护理技能成为分水岭，复合型照护员向兽医助理、店长升级。

body: 动物照护员（Animal Caretakers）负责动物的日常喂养、清洁、健康观察与基本护理，保障圈舍环境卫生和动物福利，并配合兽医进行简单医疗协助与记录管理。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能帮你记录每一顿喂食，但那只猫今天眼神不对、胃口变差，只有天天蹲在笼前的照护员知道。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can forecast fire behavior, but a supervisor still has to order the whole crew to withdraw over the radio.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), employment of First Line Supervisors Of Firefighting And Prevention Workers is projected to rise from about 97,200 in 2024 to 100,500 in 2034. That is a net increase of about 3,300 jobs, with roughly 6,500 openings each year. The median annual wage is about $92,400 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace front-line fire supervisors, but it will change dispatch and assessment. Fire data, intelligent dispatch, and drone reconnaissance improve command precision. Fireground command, crew management, and real-time decisions still depend on people. AI provides information, but the supervisor is accountable for advancing, holding, or withdrawing.
ai_s2_accel: Drone fireground reconnaissance: aerial views assist incident assessment
AI fire assessment: video and sensor data forecast spread
Smart fire station: integrated equipment location and station-entry data
Fire-service IoT: remote monitoring of building fire systems
ai_s2_auto: Intelligent emergency call handling and dispatch: automatic incident grading and optimal vehicle assignment
Fire data statistics: automated summaries of response and fire records
Training plan management: digital tracking of fitness and skills progress
Equipment management: automated vehicle and equipment records and maintenance reminders
ai_s3_list: Front-line fireground command: attack routes and withdrawal timing are life-or-death decisions.
Crew management and trust: leadership depends on trust and authority built over time.
Courage in real-time decisions: supervisors must decide even with incomplete information.
Training and mentorship: passing experience to new members sustains crew capability.
On-site coordination across agencies: people coordinate police, medical teams, and the public.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 places this career in the low-moderate exposure range. Most work occurs on scene and with crews. AI assists dispatch and statistics, but provides limited replacement for fireground command and team management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Low-moderate exposure still brings change. AI alters command methods. Supervisors who read fire data and use intelligent dispatch improve safety and efficiency. The role itself is not shrinking; technology-free management is. Better information strengthens command decisions.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Fire service follows a front-line-to-leadership path, with physical fitness as a prerequisite. Attend a fire academy or join a dedicated brigade, build incident experience as a Firefighter, and advance into supervision. Leaders who understand data analysis and intelligent dispatch receive greater responsibility in the AI era.

Use fire-assessment tools, drone reconnaissance, and intelligent dispatch instead of relying only on experience. Strengthen training and crew management while advancing from operational specialist to command specialist.

Dedicated corporate brigades, airport fire services, and fire-technology services offer another path with lower entry barriers. On a resume, quantify incidents handled, training hours led, and safety records.
Do not select supervisors on years of incident experience alone. Assess command and learning ability. Calm, decisive leaders who use data and lead teams are scarce assets worth focused development.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Incident grading, vehicle assignment, and route planning
Aerial views, thermal imaging, and fire assessment
Remote status monitoring of building fire systems
Records, maintenance reminders, and inventory movement
Group radio and shared situational awareness
Post-incident reviews, hazard reports, and training files

ai_s7_trends: Fire-service professionalization expands, creating a clear gap in front-line command. Supervisors who combine incident experience with data skill receive greater responsibility.
Drones, IoT, and intelligent dispatch become standard at fire stations, improving situational awareness and command precision.
Fire and rescue expands from firefighting toward comprehensive emergency response, broadening the supervisor's required capabilities.

body: First Line Supervisors Of Firefighting And Prevention Workers manage training, equipment maintenance, duty dispatch, and on-scene firefighting and rescue command. They also oversee fire prevention inspections and emergency decisions, connecting senior leadership with front-line Firefighters.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can forecast fire behavior, but a supervisor still has to order the whole crew to withdraw over the radio.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能提前研判火情趋势，但火场里那句「全队后撤」，还得主管对着对讲机喊出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年主管工人在岗约 9.72 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 10.05 万人，净增约 0.33 万个岗位，年均产生约 0.65 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 9.24 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代消防基层主管，但会改变「调度和研判」的方式。以前靠经验和辖区熟悉度判断火情，现在有火情数据分析、智能调度系统和无人机侦察辅助，指挥更精准。可火场指挥、队员管理、临场决断这些核心，还得靠人——AI 给信息，但「进不退、攻不攻」的拍板，是主管的责任。
ai_s2_accel: 无人机火场侦察：空中视角辅助火情判断
AI 火情研判：视频与传感器数据预测蔓延趋势
智能消防站：装备定位、出入站数据联动
消防物联网：建筑消防设施状态远程监控
ai_s2_auto: 智能接处警与调度：警情自动分级、车辆最优派单
火情数据统计：出警记录、火灾数据自动汇总
训练计划管理：体能、技能训练进度数字化
装备管理系统：车辆器材台账、保养提醒自动化
ai_s3_list: 火场一线指挥：进攻路线怎么定、撤退时机怎么把握，是生死判断。
队员管理与信任：带队伍靠的是长期相处建立的信任和威信。
临场决断的勇气：信息不全时也得拍板，这是主管的核心价值。
训练与传帮带：把经验教给新队员，是队伍战斗力的延续。
与多部门的现场协调：到场后和公安、医疗、群众怎么配合，靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业大部分工作在现场、在队伍里——调度、统计这些桌面活正被 AI 辅助，但火场指挥、队伍管理这些核心，AI 帮不上太多忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于没变化。AI 正在改变「指挥方式」：会看火情数据、会用智能调度的主管，指挥效率和安全性更高。真正被挤压的不是主管岗位本身，而是「不会用新技术」的旧式管理方式——信息掌握得越多，指挥越有底气。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 消防是「先当兵后当官」的路径，身体素质是前提。读消防院校或考专职消防，从战斗员做起，用实战积累往主管走。AI 时代，会数据分析、懂智能调度的指挥骨干更受重用。
把火情研判工具、无人机侦察、智能调度用起来，别停留在「经验指挥」。同时强化训练管理和队伍管理能力，从「战斗骨干」往「指挥骨干」升级。
企业专职消防队、机场消防、消防技术服务是另一条路，门槛比队伍招录低。简历上写「处置警情数、带队训练时长、安全记录」这类可量化成果。
选拔主管别只看实战年限，要看指挥能力和学习能力。能用数据研判、会带队伍、冷静果断的骨干，是队伍最稀缺的资产，值得重点培养。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 警情分级、车辆派单、路径规划
空中视角、热成像、火势评估
传感器数据预测蔓延趋势
建筑消防设施远程状态监测
集群对讲、现场态势共享
出警复盘、隐患上报、培训档案

ai_s7_trends: 消防职业化改革深化，基层指挥骨干缺口明显，实战经验加数据能力的复合型主管受重用。
无人机、物联网、智能调度成为消防站标配，火场信息获取更立体，指挥决策更精准。
消防救援重心从「救火」向「综合应急救援」扩展，主管的能力模型更宽。

body: 消防基层主管负责一线消防队员的训练管理、装备维护、值班调度与灭火救援现场指挥，同时承担防火检查和应急处置决策，是消防救援体系中连接「决策层」与「一线战斗员」。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Smart systems can automate ingredient mixing and robots can load materials, but questions such as why a batch turned sticky or what an unusual machine sound means still depend on an experienced worker's ear and touch.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) data show about 173,500 Food Batchmakers employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 185,400 by 2034, a net gain of about 11,900 jobs, with roughly 24,200 openings each year. Median annual pay is about $40,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI and automation will not immediately replace Food Batchmakers, but they will change the makeup of the job. Automated ingredient preparation, robotic loading, and smart temperature controls are taking over repetitive physical steps. Batchmakers are shifting from hands-on execution toward equipment monitoring, process judgment, and exception handling. Workers who can operate smart production lines and support new-product trials will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of smart recipe management systems
Expansion of fully automated filling and sealing lines
In-line inspection with AI vision
Digital twins for batch process optimization
ai_s2_auto: Automated weighing and ingredient preparation systems
Robotic material loading and handling
Automated temperature and time monitoring with records
Electronic production data capture
ai_s3_list: Process exception diagnosis: experience is needed to identify why a mixture becomes sticky, foamy, or discolored.
Equipment feel and sound: experienced workers can hear an abnormal machine or notice a temperature drift.
Experience with recipe adjustments: raw-material batches vary, and corrections must preserve taste.
Food safety details: awareness prevents foreign matter and cross-contamination before they become incidents.
Pilot runs and new-product support: experienced shop-floor workers turn a new recipe into a workable process.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means automation is taking over about half of the repetitive execution in this job. AI and robots can help with ingredient preparation, loading, and recordkeeping.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate to high exposure does not equal high risk. AI takes over standardized execution, leaving process judgment and exception handling to people. Pure material-loading roles will decline, while batchmakers who understand equipment, processes, and pilot production will gain value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study food processing, nutrition, or electromechanical technology, and get factory experience. Build both equipment-operation and food-safety skills instead of relying only on physical labor.

Master automated ingredient preparation, smart temperature controls, and vision inspection. Volunteer for new-product trials and process improvement. Move from operator to process technician and equipment specialist, and earn relevant food-safety credentials.

The entry barrier is modest, so you can start as an ingredient preparation worker or operator. On your resume, name the production lines you have run, the products you have made, and any process adjustments you supported.

Do not hire batchmakers only for their ability to perform manual work. Assess learning ability and process awareness. Employees who can adapt to smart lines while protecting food safety deserve focused development.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Precision weighing and automated material loading
ai_s6_tools.工具: Automated weighing and ingredient preparation system

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: In-line detection of foreign matter and defects

ai_s7_trends: As automated ingredient preparation and robotic loading spread, batchmakers are moving from hands-on execution toward equipment monitoring and process judgment. Smart-line experience is becoming a core advantage.
Food demand remains steady and safety oversight is tightening, increasing demand for batchmakers who understand food safety and batch traceability.
Demand is growing for flexible small-batch lines and new-product trials, favoring versatile batchmakers who can support process setup and pilot production.

body: Food Batchmakers follow established recipes and processes to prepare, weigh, load, mix, and process ingredients before packaging in food plants. They are key production workers who keep batches stable and product quality consistent.
career_ai_description_block.heading: Smart systems can automate ingredient mixing and robots can load materials, but questions such as why a batch turned sticky or what an unusual machine sound means still depend on an experienced worker's ear and touch.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 智能系统能自动配料、机器人能投料，但「这批料为什么发黏」「设备声音不对是哪的问题」，还得靠车间老师傅的耳朵和手感。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年食品批量制作工在岗约 17.35 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.54 万人，净增约 1.19 万个岗位，年均产生约 2.42 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.08 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 和自动化不会立刻取代食品批量制作工，但会改变岗位构成。自动配料、机器人投料、智能温控正在接走重复的体力环节，制作工从「动手执行」转向「设备监控、工艺判断、异常处理」。会操作智能产线、能参与新品试产的制作工，反而更吃香。
ai_s2_accel: 智能配方管理系统普及
全自动灌装封口产线扩张
AI 视觉质检在线检测
数字孪生优化批次工艺
ai_s2_auto: 自动称量与配料系统
机器人投料与搬运
温度时间自动监控记录
生产数据电子化采集
ai_s3_list: 工艺异常判断：料发黏、起泡、变色，原因靠经验定位。
设备手感与耳感：声音不对、温度偏了，老师傅听得出来。
配方微调的经验：原料批次有波动，怎么调还不影响口感。
食品安全细节：异物、交叉污染，防患于未然的意识。
试产与新品配合：新配方落地，靠现场师傅试出来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业约有一半重复执行环节正在被自动化——配料、投料、记录，AI 和机器人都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「标准化执行」，留下的是「工艺判断和异常处理」。纯投料岗会减少，懂设备、会工艺、能试产的制作工反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 选食品加工、食品营养或机电类专业，进厂实习是必须的。把设备操作和食品安全都练起来，别只做体力活。
把自动配料、智能温控、视觉质检这些新设备学熟，主动参与新品试产和工艺改进。从「操作工」升级为「工艺员+设备专家」，考食品安全相关证书。
门槛不高，可从配料工或操作工切入。简历上多写「操作过哪些产线、做过什么产品、有没有参与过工艺调整」。
招制作工别只看能干活，要看学习能力和工艺意识。能适应智能产线、又懂食品安全的员工，值得重点培养。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can help write programs, calculate parameters, and schedule production, but workpiece clamping, tool setting and alignment, and tolerance adjustment still depend on the operator's hands.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 13,800 metal and plastic machine setters, operators, and tenders were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 11,800 by 2034, a net loss of about 2,000 jobs, with approximately 1,100 openings each year. The median annual wage was about $48,300 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace milling machine operators, but it will change the role. As AI takes over automated programming, parameter optimization, production scheduling, and quality-inspection data, operators are shifting from pressing buttons to programming, understanding processes, and troubleshooting. What remains irreplaceable is the hands-on feel for clamping and tool setting, experienced judgment in choosing tools and parameters, meticulous tolerance control, and real-time handling of machining problems. AI can calculate a program, but people determine whether the setup is secure and the cut is stable.
ai_s2_accel: Wider adoption of robotic loading and unloading and automated lines
In-process measurement with automatic compensation for machining errors
AI prediction of tool wear
Digital-twin process simulation
ai_s2_auto: Automated CNC programming and parameter optimization
Automated production scheduling and job assignment
Automated quality-inspection data collection and recording
Remote equipment condition monitoring
ai_s3_list: Hands-on feel for clamping and tool setting: fixture tension and tool alignment set the starting point for accuracy, and experience makes the difference.
Tool and cutting-parameter selection: experience determines the right depth of cut, spindle speed, and feed rate.
Meticulous tolerance control: when dimensions drift, the operator must adjust compensation patiently and precisely.
Real-time handling of machining problems: unusual sounds, chipped tools, and tool deflection require human judgment about when to stop the machine.
Process feedback: people must clearly explain unreasonable programs or inadequate fixtures to technicians.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 4/10 means that workflow and recordkeeping in this occupation are being automated. Systems can handle programming, scheduling, data, and monitoring.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-high exposure does not mean high risk. As automation spreads, operators are expected to program more and understand processes better, making machine setup and troubleshooting skills scarcer. Purely manual operations face the most pressure, while versatile operators with CNC programming and process knowledge command a clear premium.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Study mechanical engineering or CNC machining and master CNC programming and CAD/CAM. Precision machining is central to advanced manufacturing, and CNC and process specialties offer stable income and career growth.

Proactively learn CNC programming, in-process measurement, and automated-line maintenance. Advance from operation to programming and setup. A skilled worker who can program will always be worth more than one who only presses buttons.

Career changers with mechanical or mold-making backgrounds can get started quickly. Enter as an operator, learn programming on the job, earn CNC and occupational skill-level certificates, and progress toward programming and process roles.

When hiring operators, look beyond hours worked to programming ability and process understanding. Young workers willing to learn automated lines and in-process measurement are the core talent smart workshops need most.

Advanced manufacturing, mold making, and aerospace components are driving precision-machining demand, while certified programming and setup professionals remain in short supply.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代眼科医师，但会压缩辅助动作。眼底读片和屈光筛查被 AI 加速，医师从写报告挪向诊断决策、手术和与患者的长期信任。真正被挤掉的是只出读片报告的，会手术能沟通的更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 病变风险预测
术式推荐
视力恢复跟踪
防盲预警
ai_s2_auto: 眼底自动识别
屈光自动筛
病历自动整
随访提醒推
ai_s3_list: 诊断决策：判断靠人。
手术操作：手感靠人。
医患信任：关系靠人。
急诊降压：决断靠人。
长期管理：节奏靠人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 6/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的医疗区——读片筛查被系统加速，但手术和信任还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是出读片报告动作，不是看眼病做手术的岗位。会手术、能跟患者建立信任的医师，反而随提效更稀缺。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 走临床医学长线，多练精细和耐心，AI 时代纯读片在缩，早点练手术。

ai_s7_trends: AI 读片普及，报告缩。
老龄化推升术量。
会手术能随诊的更抢手。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Systems can schedule appointments and calculate reimbursements, but people still decide which patient needs priority support and how to reassure a family.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 178,800 patient representatives were employed in 2024. By 2034, employment is projected to reach 188,100, a net increase of about 9,300 jobs, with about 13,600 openings per year. The median annual salary is about $48,800 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace patient representatives, but it will absorb routine inquiries. Online scheduling and self-service claims accelerate standard questions, shifting patient representatives from explaining procedures toward coordinating complex cases, providing emotional support, and connecting resources across departments. People limited to standard answers face displacement, while strong coordinators are more resilient.
ai_s2_accel: Case risk alerts
Automated follow-up reminders
Insurance plan recommendations
Intelligent care-pathway prompts
ai_s2_auto: Online appointment scheduling
Self-service reimbursement calculation
Electronic medical record access
Automated satisfaction surveys
ai_s3_list: Empathetic communication: people stabilize emotions.
Complex coordination: people connect resources.
Clinical translation: people explain medical instructions clearly.
Crisis handling: people resolve conflict.
Long-term support: people build trust.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 indicates that this service occupation has moderately high exposure. Systems accelerate standard inquiries, while people retain their role in support and coordination.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk. Answering standard process questions faces replacement, not complex case coordination. Empathetic people with coordination skills become scarcer as productivity improves. Patient representatives who merely recite procedures face greater risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: If you start in healthcare or social work, practice communication and insurance extensively. Pure inquiry handling is shrinking, so develop case-management skills early.
Advance from explaining procedures to coordination + case ownership. Learn insurance and resource connection.
Highlight service and coordination experience and clearly state which conditions you have supported. Institutions value composure and attention to detail.
When hiring, do not focus on friendliness alone. Assess whether candidates think like coordinators. Experienced staff who handle emotional labor are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Online services absorb standard inquiries.
Complex case coordination becomes more valuable.
Insurance-coordination ability commands a premium.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 系统能排预约、能算报销，但哪位患者该优先陪、怎么把家属聊稳，还是人定。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年患者代表在岗约 17.88 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 18.81 万人，净增约 0.93 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.36 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.88 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代患者代表，但会吃掉常规咨询。线上预约与自助理赔把标准问题提速，患者代表从「答流程」挪向「复杂个案协调、情绪支持、跨科资源对接」。被挤掉的是只做标准答疑的，有协调力的人更稳。

随访自动提醒
保险方案推荐
路径智能提示
ai_s2_auto: 线上预约排期
自助理赔核算
电子病历调阅
满意度自动问卷
ai_s3_list: 共情沟通：情绪靠人稳。
复杂协调：资源靠人对接。
医患翻译：医嘱靠人讲清。
危机处理：冲突靠人化解。
长期陪伴：信任靠人建。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 4/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的服务区——标准咨询被系统加速，但陪伴与协调还留着人的位置。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「答标准流程」动作，不是「复杂个案协调」的岗位。有协调力、能共情的人，反而随提效更稀缺。怕的是只会念流程的患者代表。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 医护/社工起步多练沟通和医保，纯答疑在缩，早点练个案。
从「答流程」升级成「做协调 + 养个案」，学医保与资源对接。
突出服务与协调经历，写清跟过哪些病种。机构看稳和细。
选人别只看嘴甜，要看有没有协调脑子。能扛情绪劳动的骨干值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 线上化吃标准咨询。
复杂个案协调更值钱。
医保对接能力溢价。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can model and machines can cut automatically, but scale allowance, deformation, and assembly error in patterns ultimately still depend on a master craftsperson's hands and calipers.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 500 wood patternmakers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to fall to 400 by 2034, a net loss of about 100 jobs, with about 0 openings annually and a 2026 median annual salary of about $52,500 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not immediately replace wood patternmakers, but it will change how the trade works. CAD modeling and CNC machining are taking over work from drawings to rough blanks, while 3D-printed sand molds are competing for simple patterns. The human core remains: manual assembly of complex patterns, corrections after trial casting, and customized pieces that machines cannot standardize. Traditional craftsmanship combined with new digital tools becomes more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Scanners digitally measure pattern dimensions
AI-assisted recognition of dimensions and tolerances in drawings
Widespread CNC machining reduces purely manual work
Integrated mold platforms replace traditional pattern processes
ai_s2_auto: CAD modeling replaces manual layout
CNC machines automatically cut rough pattern blanks
3D-printed sand molds create simple models
Electronic management of process parameters and drawings
ai_s3_list: Manual assembly feel: hands control errors in pattern fitting, gluing, and finishing.
Shrinkage and deformation judgment: castings shrink while cooling, and experienced craftspeople know how much allowance to leave.
On-site correction adaptability: when a casting is defective, determine whether the pattern or casting process caused it.
Process understanding for complex custom parts: know how to make a physical model beyond what the drawing specifies.
Tool and material experience: know which wood and spindle speed to use without wasting costly material.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A 5/10 means that about half of the desk-based and repetitive tasks in this occupation are becoming digital. AI and software assist with modeling, programming, and data management.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderate-to-high exposure does not mean high risk. AI takes over the standardized work from drawings to rough blanks, leaving customized correction, assembly, and trial-casting judgment. Simple patterns will become cheaper, while complex parts and correction craftsmanship become more valuable.

ai_s5_persona.建议: For this path, vocational school or CNC woodworking training is more suitable than purely theoretical education. Seek internships in foundries and mold factories, practice both drawing interpretation and manual work, and do not learn only machine operation.

Use CAD, CNC programming, and scanning measurement to advance from purely manual work to manual + digital work. Proactively take on complex prototypes and develop correction judgment, which AI cannot replace in the near term.

A woodworking background is best, but candidates without one can start as apprentices or helpers. In interviews, demonstrate that you understand drawings, describe parts you have corrected, and list machines you can operate.

Do not hire only machine operators. Versatile patternmakers who can correct patterns manually, read drawings, and learn digital tools will be scarce. Training must provide enough time for experienced craftspeople to mentor them.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Digital dimensions for patterns and castings
Cutting stock, planing, and milling shapes
Flow of drawings, parameters, and work orders

ai_s7_trends: As CAD+CNC+3D printing combinations spread, patternmaking shifts from purely manual work to digital design + manual finishing, giving workers who use digital tools a premium.
Demand remains for complex castings and prototypes, making correction, assembly, and on-site judgment scarcer and more valuable.

Experienced craftspeople's knowledge is increasingly captured digitally, turning workshop process data into company assets and increasing demand for patternmakers who contribute to process improvement.

body: Wood patternmakers create wooden casting patterns and core-box models from engineering drawings, preparing materials, laying out, machining, assembling, and finishing them. They are key manual and technical workers who turn designs into physical models ready for casting.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can model and machines can cut automatically, but scale allowance, deformation, and assembly error in patterns ultimately still depend on a master craftsperson's hands and calipers.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能建模、机床能自动切，但型板的缩尺、变形、装配误差，最终还得靠老师傅的一双手和一把卡尺。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年制版工、木材在岗约 0.05 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 0.04 万人，岗位净减约 0.01 万个，年均产生约 0.00 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 5.25 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会立刻取代木制型板工，但会改变这行的玩法。CAD 建模和 CNC 加工正在接走「从图纸到毛坯」的活，3D 打印砂型也在抢简单型板的市场。留下的核心是人做的部分：复杂型板的手工装配、试铸后的修型、以及那些「机器做不标准」的定制件。老手艺配上新数字工具，反而更吃香。
ai_s2_accel: 扫描仪数字化测量型板尺寸
AI 辅助识别图纸尺寸与公差
数控加工普及挤压纯手工环节
一体化模具平台替代传统型板工序
ai_s2_auto: CAD 建模替代手工放样
CNC 机床自动切削型板毛坯
3D 打印砂型制作简易模型
工艺参数与图纸电子化管理
ai_s3_list: 手工装配的手感：型板拼装、胶合、修整，误差靠手感控制。
缩尺与变形判断：铸件冷却会缩，留多少量是老师傅的经验。
现场修型应变：铸件有缺陷，能判断是型板还是浇铸问题。
复杂定制件的工艺理解：图纸之外，知道怎么做出实样。
刀具与材料的经验：什么木料、什么转速，坏了不心疼。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业约有一半桌面与重复环节正在被数字化——建模、编程、数据管理，AI 和软件都能帮上忙。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险。AI 接走的是「从图纸到毛坯」的标准化部分，留下的是「修型、装配、试铸判断」的定制环节。简单型板会越来越便宜，复杂件和修型手艺反而更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 想走这条路，技校或数控木工专业都比纯理论合适。实习就奔铸造厂、模具厂去，把读图和手工一起练，别只学机床。
把 CAD、CNC 编程和扫描测量用起来，从「纯手工」升级为「手工+数字」。主动接复杂试制件，练修型判断，这活儿 AI 短期替不了。
有木工基础最好，没有就从学徒或辅助工切入。面试时多展示「看得懂图纸、修过什么件、会什么机床」。
别只招会开机床的人。能手工修型、能看图纸、又愿意学数字工具的复合型板工，才是未来稀缺的。培养要舍得给老师傅带教时间。

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: 型板与铸件尺寸数字化

ai_s7_trends: CAD+CNC+3D 打印组合普及，型板制作从纯手工转向「数字设计+手工精修」，会数字工具的工人才有溢价。
复杂铸件和试制件需求仍在，修型、装配、现场判断的手艺会变得更稀缺、更值钱。
老师傅经验加速数字化沉淀，车间工艺数据成为厂里的资产，能参与工艺改进的型板工更吃香。

Accountability and final review in postal service mail carrier work.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in postal service mail carrier work.
Applying tacit knowledge gained from long-term experience in postal service mail carrier work.

Use AI to eliminate repetitive postal service mail carrier tasks and focus on decisions.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 61,900 procurement clerks were employed in 2024, falling to a projected 56,600 by 2034, a net decrease of about 5,300 jobs, with approximately 4,600 openings annually. ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace procurement clerks, but it will divert much data entry and order tracking. E-procurement, automated price comparisons, and RPA reconciliation absorb standardized tasks, shifting clerks from processing orders toward managing systems, checking exceptions, and coordinating suppliers. Data-entry-only roles face displacement, while people who manage data and supply chains are more secure.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted prediction of delivery dates and stockout risks
Intelligent warnings for abnormal orders
Automatic scoring of supplier performance
Automatic procurement reports and analysis
ai_s2_auto: Automatic validation and routing of purchase requisitions
Automatic comparison and selection of supplier quotations
RPA reconciliation of purchase orders and receipts
Automatic updates to price and supplier records
ai_s3_list: Supplier communication: people expedite orders and negotiate final payments.
Exception handling: people coordinate supply interruptions and short shipments.
Compliance assurance: conflicts of interest and integrity red lines.
Understanding demand: determine how to satisfy internal needs.
Cross-department collaboration: connect requisition through warehousing.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 7/10 places this occupation in a procurement execution area with moderately high exposure. Systems can replace requisitions, price comparisons, and reconciliation, while communication and exceptions remain human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean high risk: standardized execution is replaced, not the entire role. People who manage systems, verify exceptions, and coordinate supply chains become scarcer. Clerks limited to entering and tracking orders face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in logistics or business and practice ERP and Excel extensively in school. Data management matters in the AI era, so do not remain only an order-entry clerk.
Master ERP and automated price comparison and add supply-chain knowledge. Advance from processing orders to managing data and coordination, creating a more secure path toward procurement specialist.
Highlight the systems you managed and supply interruption exceptions you resolved. ERP and supplier experience are advantages.
Hiring should assess attention to detail and system capabilities, not just typing speed. Clerks who manage data and verify exceptions are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: As e-procurement and automated price comparisons spread, data-entry roles contract.
RPA reconciliation becomes standard, making people who verify exceptions scarcer.
Hybrid clerks who understand ERP and supply chains are more secure.

body: Procurement clerks process requisitions, requests for quotation and price comparisons, purchase-order entry, delivery follow-up, receipt reconciliation, and invoice checks in corporate procurement departments. They form the execution foundation connecting internal demand with suppliers.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can automate price comparisons and ordering, but a person still has to call and negotiate when a supplier cannot deliver this week.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能把比价和下单做成自动流程，但「这家供应商这周为什么交不了货」，还得人去催去谈。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年采购文员在岗约 6.19 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 5.66 万人，岗位净减约 0.53 万个，年均产生约 0.46 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 4.85 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代采购文员，但会大幅分流录入与跟单。电子采购、自动比价和 RPA 对账接走了标准化动作，文员从「跑单子」挪向「管系统、核异常、做供应商协调」。真正被挤掉的是只做录入的人，会管数据和供应链的人更稳。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助预测交期与缺货风险
异常订单的智能预警
供应商绩效的自动评分
采购数据的自动报表与分析
ai_s2_auto: 请购单的自动校验与流转
供应商报价的自动比价与择优
采购订单与收货的 RPA 对账
价格与供应商台账的自动更新
ai_s3_list: 供应商沟通：催货谈尾款靠人。
例外处理：断供短装要人协调。
合规把关：利益冲突与廉政红线。
需求理解：内部诉求怎么满足。
跨部协同：把请购到入库串起来。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明这个职业处在中高曝光的采购执行区——请购、比价、对账都能被系统替代，但沟通和例外仍留给人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「标准化执行」，不是「岗位」。会管系统、能核异常、做供应链协调的人，反而更稀缺。怕的是只会录单跟单的文员。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 物流商务打底，在校多练 ERP 和 Excel。AI 时代拼数据管理，别只当录单员。
把 ERP 和自动比价玩熟，补供应链常识。从「跑单」升级成「管数据与协调」，转采购专员更稳。
突出你管过什么系统、处理过什么断供异常。有 ERP 和供应商经验优先。
招人看细心和系统能力，不止看打字。能管数据核异常的文员值得留用。

ai_s7_trends: 电子采购与自动比价普及，录入岗压缩。
RPA 对账成标配，异常核对人更稀缺。
会 ERP 与供应链的复合文员更稳。

body: 采购文员在企业采购部门处理请购、询价比价、采购订单录入、交期跟催、收货对账与票据核对，是连接内部需求与供应商的执行基础岗位。
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI 能把比价和下单做成自动流程，但「这家供应商这周为什么交不了货」，还得人去催去谈。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can classify an entire agricultural region overnight, but technicians must use field samples to verify whether the categories and boundaries are accurate.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 83,200 remote sensing technicians were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 86,200 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,000 jobs, with about 10,600 openings annually. Median annual pay was about $60,100 in 2026 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace remote sensing technicians, but it will take over routine workflows. Image preprocessing, automated classification, and change detection increasingly resemble standardized services. Technicians' value shifts to verification, judgment, and delivery: knowing whether results are accurate, why they are wrong, how to fix them, and how to make outputs useful to the business. Technicians who use AI double their efficiency, while those who only click through software workflows will be eliminated.
ai_s2_accel: Online processing of remote sensing big data on cloud platforms
Automated drone image stitching and modeling
AI-assisted automatic labeling of ground samples
Multisource data fusion improving interpretation accuracy
ai_s2_auto: Automated geometric and atmospheric correction of imagery
AI automated classification and feature recognition
Batch change detection
Automated thematic map and report templates
ai_s3_list: Quality judgment: identify errors and confidence in processing results.
Field verification: practical ground control point and sample collection skills.
Business translation: explain imagery conclusions in language stakeholders can use.
Exception handling: alternatives for missing data and cloud cover.
Project management: coordinate multitemporal data and stakeholder needs.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 means remote sensing data processing is highly penetrated by AI. Preprocessing and classification already have high automation. Technician roles will not disappear but move upward into verification, quality control, delivery, and industry applications. AI lowers entry barriers and amplifies the value of people who use results correctly.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure requires transition. Stop being only a software operator and move toward industry applications + data quality control. Agriculture, carbon-neutrality, and disaster monitoring need versatile technicians who understand both remote sensing and the business, and AI only increases their value.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Remote sensing and geographic information are technically stable fields with broad employment but average starting pay. When choosing a program, prioritize hands-on practice and project partnerships and prepare for a dual rhythm of screen work + fieldwork.

Start learning AI interpretation tools and cloud platforms immediately rather than remaining with traditional software. Choose one industry to specialize in, such as agriculture, environmental protection, or carbon neutrality. Connecting imagery + business is the fastest path to advancement and higher pay.

People with surveying, GIS, or environmental backgrounds have an advantage when transitioning. Learn Python and common AI interpretation frameworks and build several projects with open data. In job applications, show which data you processed and which problems you solved rather than listing software names.

When hiring, look beyond the number of software packages to data quality judgment and industry understanding. Give technicians AI tools to reduce repetitive work and invest human effort in field verification and client communication for the greatest quality improvement.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Control points, photographs, and sample records

ai_s7_trends: As AI interpretation and cloud platforms spread, image processing shifts from specialized technical work to a standard service.
Remote sensing applications penetrate deeply into agriculture, carbon neutrality, disasters, and other business settings.
Versatile technicians combining remote sensing + business + data quality control become essential.

body: Remote sensing technicians collect, process, and interpret satellite, aerial, and drone imagery. They perform geometric correction, image classification, change detection, and mapping to provide spatial data products for surveying, agriculture, environmental protection, disaster monitoring, and other fields.
career_ai_description_block.heading: AI can classify an entire agricultural region overnight, but technicians must use field samples to verify whether the categories and boundaries are accurate.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI 能一夜之间把整片耕地自动分类，但「分类对不对、边界准不准」，得技术员带着野外样本去较真。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年遥感技术员在岗约 8.32 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 8.62 万人，净增约 0.30 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.06 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.01 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代遥感技术员，但会接管「跑流程」：影像预处理、自动分类、变化检测越来越像标准服务。技术员的价值转移到「验证、判断、交付」——知道结果准不准、为什么不准、怎么修，以及如何让成果真正被业务用起来。会用 AI 的技术员效率翻倍，只会在软件里点按钮的会被淘汰。
ai_s2_accel: 云平台遥感大数据在线处理
无人机影像自动拼接与建模
AI 辅助地面样本自动标记
多源数据融合提升解译精度
ai_s2_auto: 影像几何校正与大气校正自动化
AI 自动分类与地物识别
变化检测批量处理
专题图与报告模板自动生成
ai_s3_list: 质量判断：识别处理结果的误差与可信度。
野外验证：地面打点与样本采集的实操能力。
业务翻译：把影像结论讲成业务方能用的语言。
异常处置：数据缺失、云覆盖时的替代方案。
项目管理：多期数据、多方需求的统筹。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 7/10 说明遥感数据处理是典型的「AI 高度渗透」环节：预处理和分类自动化程度已经很高。但技术员岗位不会消失，而是上移到验证、质控、交付和行业应用层——AI 降低了门槛，也放大了「能把成果用对」的人的价值。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光意味着必须转型：别再当「软件操作员」，往「行业应用 + 数据质控」走。农业、双碳、灾害监测这些方向缺的是既懂遥感又懂业务的复合技术员，AI 只会让这类人更值钱。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 遥感与地理信息是「技术稳定型」方向，就业面广但起点收入一般。建议选校时看重实践和项目合作多的专业，孩子要能接受「屏幕 + 野外」的双重工作节奏。
立刻开始学 AI 解译工具和云平台，别停留在传统软件操作。同时选一个行业深耕（农业、环保、双碳），把「影像 + 业务」打通，是升职加薪最快的路径。
有测绘、GIS 或环境背景的人转型有优势。先补 Python 和常见 AI 解译框架，用开源数据做几个作品；求职时重点展示「处理过什么数据、解决了什么问题」，比罗列软件名有用。
招聘时别只看会几个软件，重点考察「数据质量判断能力和行业理解」。给技术员配 AI 工具减少重复劳动，把人力投入到野外验证和客户沟通上，项目质量提升最明显。

ai_s7_trends: AI 解译与云平台普及，影像处理从「技术活」变成「标准服务」。
遥感应用向农业、双碳、灾害等业务场景深度下沉。
「遥感 + 业务 + 数据质控」复合技术员成为行业刚需。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: A housing system can assign rooms automatically, but advisors still determine when two roommates are incompatible and who seems unwell tonight through daily interaction.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS), about 91,200 residential advisors were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to rise to 94,700 by 2034, a net increase of about 3,500 jobs, with about 17,400 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 is approximately $39,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace residential advisors, but it will assist with administrative work. Room assignment, maintenance, and notification systems accelerate routine tasks, moving advisors from recording assignments toward conflict mediation + crisis intervention + supportive presence. People who only maintain housing records face displacement, while those who communicate and intervene effectively become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Conflict risk alerts
Emotion-recognition assistance
Activity registration management
Security patrol check-ins
ai_s2_auto: Smart housing and room assignments
Automated maintenance dispatch
Notification and check-in systems
Housing data dashboards
ai_s3_list: Conflict mediation: people calm emotions.
Crisis intervention: people handle emergencies.
Supportive presence: people recognize changing conditions.
Maintaining boundaries: people exercise discretion.
On-site judgment: people assess severity.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 places this occupation in an administrative field with moderate AI exposure. Systems accelerate room assignments and maintenance requests, while interpersonal support remains human-led.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not equal high risk. Automation replaces room assignment and recordkeeping, not mediation and intervention. As systems expand, people who communicate well and maintain boundaries become scarcer. Those who only record housing assignments face the greatest risk.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a foundation in a related field and practice communication and empathy. Pure room-assignment work is shrinking in the AI era, so develop mediation skills early.
Advance from room assignments to mediation + intervention by learning psychology and crisis-response tools.
Highlight mediation and crisis cases and specify the size of the area you managed.
Do not select candidates only for diligence. Evaluate their communication and boundaries. People who can stabilize difficult situations are worth retaining.

ai_s7_trends: Room assignments and maintenance requests are moving into systems.
Conflict alert tools are emerging.
Advisors who mediate and intervene effectively have more stable prospects.

body: Residential advisors manage occupancy and order in residence halls and institutional housing, mediate conflicts, provide support and crisis intervention, organize activities, and protect resident safety and experience.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 排宿系统能自动分房，但那两个室友合不来、谁今晚状态不对，还是顾问凭相处定的。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年住宿顾问在岗约 9.12 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 9.47 万人，净增约 0.35 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.74 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 3.92 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代住宿顾问，但会辅助事务。排宿、报修与通知系统把琐事提速，顾问从「记排宿」挪向「冲突调解 + 危机干预 + 陪伴支持」。真正被挤掉的是只做排宿记录的人，会沟通能干预的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 矛盾风险预警
情绪识别辅助
活动报名管理
安全巡更打卡
ai_s2_auto: 智能排宿分房
报修自动派单
通知与签到系统
住宿数据看板
ai_s3_list: 冲突调解：情绪靠人抚。

边界把握：分寸靠人守。
现场判断：轻重靠人辨。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这个职业处在中 AI 曝光的事务区——排宿报修被系统提速，人际支持还留人。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 中高曝光不等于高风险：被替代的是「排宿与记录」动作，不是「调解与干预」的岗位。会沟通、能守边界的人反而随系统化更稀缺。怕的是只会记排宿的人。

从「排宿」升级成「调解 + 干预」，学心理与危机工具。
突出调解和危机案例，写清管过多大片区。
选人别只看勤快，看会不会沟通和守边界。能稳场的人值得留。

ai_s7_trends: 排宿报修上系统。
矛盾预警工具起步。
会调解能干预的顾问更稳。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: AI can absorb much of the repetitive, structurable work of Supply Chain Managers, but judgment, accountability, and interpersonal coordination still rest with people. What actually gets squeezed out is pure execution.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 216,700 supply chain managers were employed in 2024, projected to rise to 229,800 by 2034, a net gain of about 13,100 jobs, with about 18,500 openings annually. The median annual wage in 2026 was about $102,000 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace supply chain managers, but it will reshape their workflows by assigning repetitive, structured tasks to tools while people focus on judgment, accountability, and creativity. Formulaic execution will face pressure, while professionals who apply expertise to real situations and make sound decisions will become more valuable.
ai_s2_accel: Use data profiles to accelerate customer or learning-status assessments in supply chain management.
Use simulations and scenario exercises to accelerate supply chain plan evaluation.
Use retrieval tools to verify supply chain information and regulations.
Use collaboration tools to accelerate cross-functional supply chain coordination.
ai_s2_auto: Automatically generate structured documents and reports for supply chain management.
Process and classify repetitive supply chain management data.
Perform initial rule-based screening and scheduling for supply chain operations.
Search supply chain management knowledge bases and extract key points.
ai_s3_list: Professional judgment and tradeoffs in real supply chain management scenarios.
The ability to explain supply chain management expertise to non-specialists.
Accountability and final review in supply chain management.
Cross-boundary resource integration and interpersonal coordination in supply chain management.
Reapplying tacit knowledge accumulated through long-term supply chain experience.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: Scoring rationale: AI can assist supply chain management, but professional judgment and accountable final review are difficult to replace, resulting in an exposure score of 7/10.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Turn 7/10 into an advantage: let AI take the repetitive work, and spend your time on real projects, judgment, and people.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Build a strong foundation in supply chain management and accumulate experience on real projects.
Connect prior experience to supply chain management and identify a differentiated entry point.
Turn supply chain management experience into products or management systems to increase leverage.
Use AI to eliminate repetitive supply chain work and focus on decisions.

ai_s6_tools.代表能力: Supply chain copy and plan drafts

ai_s7_trends: First, collaboration between supply chain managers and AI will become standard, making tool proficiency an entry requirement.
Second, high-value judgment and accountability in supply chain management will become scarcer.
Third, supply chain roles will evolve toward combinations of professional expertise with management or product skills.

body: Supply chain managers coordinate procurement, production, warehousing, and distribution. They use demand forecasts and inventory strategies to balance cost, lead time, and service levels, ensuring goods reach the right place at the right time.

ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年供应链经理在岗约 21.67 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 22.98 万人，净增约 1.31 万个岗位，年均产生约 1.85 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 10.20 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代供应链经理，但会重塑Supply Chain Managers的作业流：把重复与可结构化任务交给工具，人聚焦判断、责任与创造。真正被挤掉的是照本宣科式执行，会结合真实场景、会决策的人更值钱。
ai_s2_accel: 用数据画像加速Supply Chain Managers的客情/学情判断。
用模拟与沙盘加速Supply Chain Managers的方案推演。
用检索增强Supply Chain Managers的资料与法规查证。
用协作工具加速Supply Chain Managers的跨团队协同。
ai_s2_auto: 自动生成Supply Chain Managers相关的结构化文档与报告。
对Supply Chain Managers的重复性数据处理与归类。
基于规则的Supply Chain Managers初步筛查与排程。
Supply Chain Managers知识库检索与要点提取。
ai_s3_list: 真实Supply Chain Managers场景下的专业判断与权衡。
把Supply Chain Managers专业知识讲给外行听的表达力。
Supply Chain Managers领域的责任承担与终审。
跨边界的Supply Chain Managers资源整合与人际协调。

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: Software can handle programming and inspection, but AI still struggles to answer the question of where a die needs repair.
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: Data from the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) show that about 55,200 tool and die makers were employed in 2024. Employment is projected to decline to 49,300 by 2034, a net decrease of about 5,900 jobs, with approximately 4,700 openings annually. Median annual pay in 2026 is about $63,200 (BLS OOH, 2026).
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI will not replace tool and die makers, but it will clearly change how they work. Automated programming, simulation, and in-process inspection reduce trial-and-error costs. Software now calculates process parameters that experienced craftspeople once discovered through expensive experiments. What remains irreplaceable is process judgment: how materials deform under heat, where fitting surfaces need scraping, and whether a tryout defect comes from the cavity or gate. These abilities accumulate through decades of field experience.
ai_s2_accel: AI-assisted identification of tryout defect causes
Toolpath optimization to reduce air cutting and deformation
Automatic compensation for machining errors through in-process measurement feedback
Digital-twin monitoring across the die life cycle
ai_s2_auto: Automatic generation and post-processing of CNC programs
Parametric die design and simulation validation
Automated dimensional inspection and reporting
Tool-life management and process-parameter records
ai_s3_list: Process planning: Comprehensive consideration of materials, machining allowance, fixturing, and heat-treatment sequence.
Tactile assembly and fitting: Micron-level adjustment of contact surfaces and closure accuracy with red lead.
Tryout defect diagnosis: On-site judgment determines whether shrinkage, flash, or scoring comes from temperature or pressure.
Exception handling: On-site recovery from chipped tools, broken taps, and heat-treatment cracks.
Balancing cost and schedule: Tradeoffs between precision requirements and machining cost.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: A score of 5/10 means that half the work, including programming, measurement, and parameter recording, is being taken over by software and automation. This is an occupation with medium AI exposure.
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: Moderately high exposure does not mean half the jobs disappear. Workers limited to following programs face replacement, while process design and die-repair diagnosis gain importance. People who both program and repair dies are increasingly scarce at die shops, strengthening their bargaining power.

ai_s5_persona.建议: Do not feel embarrassed about studying die making or CNC at vocational school. This is one of the few trades that becomes more valuable with age. Master CAD/CAM and CNC programming in school, then spend two years learning from an experienced craftsperson. Your starting position will be well above that of a general assembly-line worker.

Address software gaps by learning automated programming, simulation, and in-process inspection. Advance from single-machine operation to process expertise, programming, and die repair, creating a stronger basis for negotiating pay.

A mechanical foundation makes entry easier. On your resume, specify the die types you built, tolerances achieved, and typical defects repaired. This is far more useful than stating that you can operate machine tools.

Do not recruit only experienced workers. Build a pipeline of apprentices working with senior craftspeople. Pay a premium for hybrid skills in programming + processes + die repair to preserve veteran craftsmanship.

ai_s7_trends: Automated programming and simulation become standard, significantly reducing the number of tryouts.
Digital die management spreads, creating premiums for die makers who interpret data and maintain digital twins.
Retirements among senior craftspeople accelerate, further expanding the shortage of hybrid die-making talent.

body: Tool and die makers design, manufacture, fit, and repair stamping dies, injection molds, die-casting dies, specialized tools, and fixtures. Their work includes reading drawings, machining, heat treatment, assembly, tryouts, and repair, making it one of manufacturing's most precision-intensive trades.

ai_impact_table.ai_head_sub: 编程和检测交给软件，但「修模修哪儿」这道题，AI 还答不利索。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_bls: 美国劳工统计局（BLS） 的数据显示，2024 年工具和模具制造工在岗约 5.52 万人，到 2034 年预计升至 4.93 万人，岗位净减约 0.59 万个，年均产生约 0.47 万个职位空缺，2026 年中位数年薪约 6.32 万美元（BLS OOH，2026）。
ai_impact_table.ai_s1_p: AI 不会取代工具和模具制造工，但会明显改变干活方式：自动编程、仿真模拟、在线检测已经在压缩「试错」成本，过去靠老师傅烧钱试出来的工艺参数，现在软件先算一遍。真正替代不了的是工艺判断——材料受热怎么变形、研配该刮哪里、试模缺陷出在型腔还是浇口，这些是几十年现场经验堆出来的。
ai_s2_accel: AI 辅助识别试模缺陷原因
加工路径优化减少空走刀与变形
在线测量反馈自动补偿加工误差
模具全寿命数字孪生监控
ai_s2_auto: 数控加工程序的自动生成与后处理
模具设计的参数化与仿真验证
尺寸检测与报告的自动化
刀具寿命管理与工艺参数记录
ai_s3_list: 工艺方案制定：材料、余量、装夹、热处理顺序的通盘考虑。
装配与研配手感：红丹研配、合模精度的微米级调整。
试模缺陷诊断：缩水、飞边、拉伤背后是温度还是压力，要现场判断。
异常处置：崩刀、断丝锥、热处理开裂的现场救场。
成本与工期平衡：精度要求和加工成本的取舍。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p: 5/10 说明这行一半的活——编程、测量、参数记录——正在被软件和自动化接管，属于「中等接触面」的职业。
ai_impact_table.ai_s4_p2: 但中高曝光不代表岗位减半：被替代的是「只会按程序走」的单一技能工，而被加码的是工艺设计、修模诊断这些复合能力。会编程又会修模的人，在模具厂越来越稀缺，议价权在涨。

ai_s5_persona.建议: 读技校模具或数控专业不要怕「没面子」，这是少数越老越吃香的手艺岗。在校就把 CAD/CAM 和数控编程练熟，毕业再跟两年师傅，起点比流水线普工高一个段位。
把软件短板补上：自动编程、仿真模拟、在线检测都值得学。从「单机操作」升级成「懂工艺、会编程、能修模」，以后谈薪资才有底气。
有机械基础再入行更顺。简历上写清楚做过什么类型的模具、公差做到多少、修过哪些典型缺陷，比写「会操作机床」有用得多。
别只招「熟手」，要有梯队地招学徒跟老师傅。给复合型技能——编程 + 工艺 + 修模——开溢价，才是留住老师傅手艺的正确姿势。

ai_s7_trends: 自动编程与仿真成为标配，试模次数显著减少。
模具数字化管理普及，会看数据、会维护数字孪生的模具工溢价。
老师傅退休潮加剧，复合型模具人才缺口持续扩大。
